subject: Satellite apps provisioning & rollout checklist
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlane.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@starlane.io
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New satellite apps — provisioning & timelines

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We want to move forward with provisioning for three additional internal projects that will each talk to the Redwood API:

- PatientNotifications (mobile push + templated content) — ~25 TPS peak
- ClaimsParser (batch jobs & inference pipelines) — scheduled peak windows, ~50 TPS
- IntakeForms (web forms, low latency) — ~40 TPS with spike tolerance

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Separate API keys per project (so security/rotation is per-app).
2) A rollout plan for staggering activation over 3 weeks.
3) Any recommended routing or caching profiles to keep cost predictable.
4) A draft amendment for the term/commit increase — Starlane legal will want the scope added.

Can you confirm who on your side will own key issuance and whether we should sign an MoA/Amendment now or wait until the first project goes live?

Appreciate a checklist/owner breakdown — we’re aiming to start provisioning the week of May 22.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops | Starlane Health
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlane.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New satellite apps — provisioning & timelines

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support per-project keys and a staggered activation. High level plan below — attaching a short provisioning checklist and draft MoA for your review.

High level (target start week of May 22):
- Week 1 (May 22): PatientNotifications — issue keys, enable prefix caching, lighter quantization profile for cost predictability.
- Week 2 (May 29): IntakeForms — low-latency routing, smaller batch windows to keep p99 latency tight.
- Week 3 (Jun 5): ClaimsParser — batch-optimized routing, higher concurrency and optional dedicated pool if throughput exceeds baseline.

Owners on our side:
- Key issuance & segmentation: Sergio Alvarez (I’ll provision and rotate keys).
- Commercial/term amendment: Lauren Bishop (cc’d).
- Capacity and Dedicated pool assessment: Ben Carter (cc’d).
- Onboarding runbooks & evals: Grace O’Connor (cc’d).

Quick answers to your bullets:
1) Separate API keys: yes — each key will be labeled by project and environment.
2) Rollout plan: see above; we’ll produce a calendar invite for each activation.
3) Routing/caching recommendations: we’ll start PatientNotifications with prefix caching + batching disabled for user-facing templates; ClaimsParser should start with aggressive batching and a higher token quota. Grace will attach recommended profiles.
4) MoA/Amendment: attaching a draft. Lauren, can you confirm whether legal prefers the amendment signed before the first activation or after a 30-day pilot?

Attachments: starlane-provision-checklist.pdf, starlane-moa-draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoffs after Lauren confirms the contract cadence.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlane.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New satellite apps — provisioning & timelines

Hi Marta,

Signed/contractual note: Starlane’s increase in committed tokens/month will trigger a term amendment and an updated SOW that enumerates the three projects as covered scopes. From a commercial perspective we can do either:

Option A — Sign amendment before activation: faster procurement runway for Starlane (preferred if legal needs the change up front).
Option B — 30-day pilot with estimated commit and then sign: useful if you want to validate traffic shapes first.

If you’re comfortable with the commit estimates you sent, we can prepare Amendment v1 today and route for electronic signature. If you prefer the pilot, we’ll note the pilot metrics and convert the pilot to committed usage in the amendment.

Operational asks before we flip keys live:
- Confirm the email for security rotation notifications (ops@starlane.io).
- Confirm whether any of the three projects require HIPAA BAAs or specific logging retention beyond our standard enterprise package.

Ben, quick ask: can you confirm capacity headroom in our Dedicated pools if Starlane wants to burst ClaimsParser to 100 TPS for a short window?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlane.io>, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New satellite apps — provisioning & timelines

Lauren / team — quick capacity note:

We have spare headroom in Dedicated Pool B for short bursts: up to 120 TPS for ~2 hour windows with pre-warm. For ClaimsParser, if you expect sustained 100 TPS we should either:
- Allocate a temporary dedicated burst reservation the week ClaimsParser goes live (preferred), or
- Use our autoscaled Dedicated with a higher burst budget and a short-term commit amendment.

Operationally I recommend:
1) We provision per-app keys now (Sergio).
2) We set up a single temporary burst reservation for ClaimsParser on Jun 5 (Ben to own).
3) Starlane signs Amendment v1 before the IntakeForms activation (May 29) if legal prefers the start-of-term approach.

Grace will follow up with the exact caching/routing profiles and a short eval checklist to validate p99 latency during the first 48 hours of each activation.

Ben Carter
Solutions & Capacity, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
